summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing a three-year agreement with Golomax and Picking Up in Argentina. The agreement forecasts $20 million revenue for RedCloud from digitization, RAID, and trade growth fees, with approximately $1.2 billion in FMCG goods traded through RedAI. This is a commercial partnership, not a special situation. RedCloud will deploy RedAI RAID into existing networks under a revenue-share model. No securities transactions, M&A, or strategic events are involved. Watch for execution and revenue realization, but no risk-arb angle applies.
